    [31mfunction TemplateEditor({[39m

    [31m  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);·[39m
    [31m  // Template DOCX (VI/EN)[39m
    [31m  const [tplFiles, setTplFiles] = useState<[39m
    [31m    Record<string, { filename: string; size: number; updated_at?: string }>[39m
    [31m  >({});[39m
    [31m  const [tplUploading, setTplUploading] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
    [31m  const [tplLang, setTplLang] = useState<\"vi\" | \"en\">(\"vi\");[39m

    [31m  const [refLang, setRefLang] = useState<\"vi\" | \"en\">(\"vi\");[39m
    [31m  const [refFilesByLang, setRefFilesByLang] = useState<[39m
    [31m    Record<string, TemplateFile[]>[39m
    [31m  >({ vi: [], en: [] });·[39m
    [31m  const loadFiles = useCallback(() => {[39m
    [31m    fetch(`${API}/admin/templates/${docTypeId}/files`, {[39m
    [31m      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },[39m
    [31m    })[39m
    [31m      .then((r) => r.json())[39m
    [31m      .then((d) => {[39m
    [31m        if (d.files_by_lang) {[39m
    [31m          setRefFilesByLang({[39m

    [31m            en: d.files_by_lang.en || [],[39m
    [31m          });[39m
    [31m          // Keep `files` in sync for backwards compat[39m
    [31m          setFiles([[39m
    [31m            ...(d.files_by_lang.vi || []),[39m
    [31m            ...(d.files_by_lang.en || []),[39m

    [31m          ]);[39m

    [31m    fetch(`${API}/admin/templates/${docTypeId}`, {[39m
    [31m      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },[39m
    [31m    })[39m
    [31m      .then((r) => r.json())[39m
    [31m      .then((d) => {[39m

    [31m      })[39m

    [31m  useEffect(() => {[39m
    [31m    load();[39m

    [31m    loadRevisions();[39m
    [31m    loadTplFiles();[39m
    [31m  }, [load, loadFiles, loadRevisions, loadTplFiles]);·[39m
    [31m  const uploadFile = async (file: File, fileLang?: string) => {[39m
    [31m    const targetLang = fileLang || refLang;[39m
    [31m    setUploading(true);[39m
    [31m    setUploadError(null);[39m
    [31m    const form = new FormData();[39m
    [31m    form.append(\"file\", file);[39m
    [31m    form.append(\"lang\", targetLang);[39m
    [31m    try {[39m
    [31m      const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/templates/${docTypeId}/files`, {[39m
    [31m        method: \"POST\",[39m
    [31m        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },[39m
    [31m        body: form,[39m
    [31m      });[39m
    [31m      if (!res.ok) {[39m
    [31m        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));[39m
    [31m        throw new Error(parseApiError(err, `HTTP ${res.status}`));[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      loadFiles();[39m
    [31m    } catch (err) {[39m
    [31m      setUploadError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Upload thất bại\");[39m
    [31m    } finally {[39m
    [31m      setUploading(false);[39m
    [31m      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = \"\";[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  };·[39m
    [31m  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {[39m
    [31m    const file = e.target.files?.[0];[39m
    [31m    if (file) uploadFile(file);[39m
    [31m  };·[39m
    [31m  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {[39m
    [31m    e.preventDefault();[39m
    [31m    setDragOver(false);[39m
    [31m    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];[39m
    [31m    if (file) uploadFile(file);[39m
    [31m  };·[39m
    [31m  const handleDeleteFile = async (filename: string) => {[39m
    [31m    setDeletingFile(filename);[39m
    [31m    try {[39m
    [31m      await fetch([39m
    [31m        `${API}/admin/templates/${docTypeId}/files/${encodeURIComponent(filename)}?lang=${refLang}`,[39m

    [31m          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },[39m
    [31m        },[39m
    [31m      );[39m
    [31m      loadFiles();[39m
    [31m    } finally {[39m
    [31m      setDeletingFile(null);[39m

    [31m// ─── Placeholder Manager ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────·[39m
    [31mfunction PlaceholderManager({ token }: { token: string }) {[39m
    [31m  const [placeholders, setPlaceholders] = useState<any[]>([]);[39m
    [31m  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);[39m
    [31m  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);[39m
    [31m  const [editKey, setEditKey] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m
    [31m  const [form, setForm] = useState({[39m
    [31m    key: \"\",[39m
    [31m    label: \"\",[39m
    [31m    description: \"\",[39m
    [31m    default_value: \"\",[39m
    [31m    source: \"\",[39m
    [31m  });[39m
    [31m  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);[39m
    [31m  const [error, setError] = useState(\"\");·[39m
    [31m  const authHdr = { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` };·[39m
    [31m  const fetchPlaceholders = useCallback(async () => {[39m
    [31m    setLoading(true);[39m
    [31m    try {[39m
    [31m      const res = await fetch(`${API}/admin/placeholders`, {[39m
    [31m        headers: authHdr,[39m
    [31m      });[39m
    [31m      if (res.ok) {[39m
    [31m        const d = await res.json();[39m
    [31m        setPlaceholders(d.placeholders || []);[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m    } finally {[39m
    [31m      setLoading(false);[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  }, [token]);·[39m
    [31m  useEffect(() => {[39m
    [31m    fetchPlaceholders();[39m
    [31m  }, [fetchPlaceholders]);·[39m
    [31m  const openAdd = () => {[39m
    [31m    setEditKey(null);[39m
    [31m    setForm({[39m
    [31m      key: \"\",[39m
    [31m      label: \"\",[39m
    [31m      description: \"\",[39m
    [31m      default_value: \"\",[39m
    [31m      source: \"\",[39m
    [31m    });[39m
    [31m    setError(\"\");[39m
    [31m    setShowForm(true);[39m
    [31m  };·[39m
    [31m  const openEdit = (p: any) => {[39m
    [31m    setEditKey(p.key);[39m
    [31m    setForm({[39m
    [31m      key: p.key,[39m
    [31m      label: p.label,[39m
    [31m      description: p.description || \"\",[39m
    [31m      default_value: p.default_value || \"\",[39m
    [31m      source: p.source || \"\",[39m
    [31m    });[39m
    [31m    setError(\"\");[39m
    [31m    setShowForm(true);[39m
    [31m  };·[39m
    [31m  const handleSave = async () => {[39m
    [31m    if (!form.key || !form.label) return;[39m
    [31m    setSaving(true);[39m
    [31m    setError(\"\");[39m
    [31m    try {[39m
    [31m      const isEdit = !!editKey;[39m
    [31m      const url = isEdit[39m
    [31m        ? `${API}/admin/placeholders/${editKey}`[39m
    [31m        : `${API}/admin/placeholders`;[39m
    [31m      const res = await fetch(url, {[39m
    [31m        method: isEdit ? \"PUT\" : \"POST\",[39m
    [31m        headers: { ...authHdr, \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },[39m
    [31m        body: JSON.stringify(form),[39m
    [31m      });[39m
    [31m      if (!res.ok) {[39m
    [31m        const e = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));[39m
    [31m        setError(e.detail || \"Lỗi\");[39m
    [31m        return;[39m
    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      setShowForm(false);[39m
    [31m      setEditKey(null);[39m
    [31m      setForm({[39m
    [31m        key: \"\",[39m
    [31m        label: \"\",[39m
    [31m        description: \"\",[39m
    [31m        default_value: \"\",[39m
    [31m        source: \"\",[39m
    [31m      });[39m
    [31m      fetchPlaceholders();[39m
    [31m    } finally {[39m
    [31m      setSaving(false);[39m
    [31m    }[39m
    [31m  };·[39m
    [31m  const handleDelete = async (key: string) => {[39m
    [31m    if (!confirm(`Xoá placeholder {{${key}}}?`)) return;[39m
    [31m    await fetch(`${API}/admin/placeholders/${key}`, {[39m
    [31m      method: \"DELETE\",[39m
    [31m      headers: authHdr,[39m
    [31m    });[39m
    [31m    fetchPlaceholders();[39m
    [31m  };·[39m
    [31m  const inputStyle = {[39m
    [31m    background: \"#FFFFFF\",[39m
    [31m    border: \"1px solid #E2E8F0\",[39m
    [31m    color: \"#0A1F44\",[39m
    [31m  };·[39m
    [31m  return ([39m
    [31m    <div className=\"space-y-4\">[39m
    [31m      {/* Header */}[39m
    [31m      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">[39m
    [31m        <div>[39m
    [31m          <h2 className=\"text-lg font-bold\" style={{ color: \"#0A1F44\" }}>[39m
    [31m            Quản lý Placeholders[39m
    [31m          </h2>[39m
    [31m          <p className=\"text-xs mt-0.5\" style={{ color: \"#6B7280\" }}>[39m
    [31m            Định nghĩa các biến dùng trong template DOCX. Dùng cú pháp{\" \"}[39m
    [31m            {`{{key}}`} trong file mẫu.[39m
    [31m          </p>[39m
    [31m        </div>[39m

    [31m  if (d === 0) return \"Hôm nay\";[39m

    [31m  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString(\"vi-VN\");[39m

    [31mfunction TemplateEditor({[39m

    [31m  // Template DOCX (VI/EN)[39m

    [31m    Record<string, { filename: string; size: number; updated_at?: string }>[39m
    [31m  >({});[39m
    [31m  const [tplUploading, setTplUploading] = useState<string | null>(null);[39m

    [31m  const uploadFile = async (file: File, fileLang?: string) => {[39m
    [31m    const targetLang = fileLang || refLang;[39m

    [31m      });[39m
    [31m      if (!res.ok) {[39m
    [31m        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));[39m

    [31m      }[39m
    [31m      loadFiles();[39m
    [31m    } catch (err) {[39m
    [31m      setUploadError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : \"Upload thất bại\");[39m
